selection_notes: Audio files are not vendored in this repository.
Use this catalog to pick public datasets, understand licensing, and stage local training data.
For a first microWakeWord run, prefer the upstream kahrendt/microwakeword features plus a small amount of local positive wake phrase audio.

datasets.name: microWakeWord precomputed feature dataset
datasets.license: Mixed upstream sources; verify the dataset card and source licenses before redistribution.
datasets.redistribution: Do not copy feature archives into this repo.
datasets.format: mmap ninja spectrogram feature zip files
notes: This is the most directly useful public asset for this starter because it is already shaped for microWakeWord training.
Dataset Viewer does not expose row splits because the files are feature archives rather than parquet/audio rows.

datasets.name: Google Speech Commands v0.02
datasets.redistribution: Small attributed excerpts may be redistributed under CC-BY-4.0, but this repo keeps audio downloads local by default.
datasets.size: v0.02 download about 2.29 GB; dataset about 3.16 GB
notes: Includes command words, auxiliary words, and a _silence_ class.
Useful for tests, not a replacement for phrase-specific wake word positives.

datasets.name: MLCommons Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus microset
datasets.redistribution: Follow MLCommons mirror terms; do not attempt to identify speakers.
datasets.size: microset about 584 MB; full dataset about 124 GB
notes: The full MSWC corpus has more than 23 million one-second spoken examples in 50 languages.
The microset is the practical choice for a small repo workflow.

datasets.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 25.0
datasets.license: CC0-1.0 for standard Common Voice scripted datasets; verify each language datasheet.
datasets.redistribution: Do not re-host or re-share Common Voice audio; download from Mozilla Data Collective.
notes: Useful as negative speech, not as direct positive wake phrase data.
Mozilla Data Collective terms forbid trying to identify speakers.

datasets.name: FSD50K
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset-level; check bundled LICENSE-DATASET and clip attribution.
datasets.redistribution: Keep attribution and license files with downloaded audio.
datasets.format: WAV audio clips with ontology labels
notes: Good source for household, music, animal, and environmental sounds.
Filter out classes that sound too close to the target wake phrase unless using them as hard negatives intentionally.

datasets.name: Microsoft DNS Challenge 5
datasets.license: Mixed dataset licenses plus MIT/CC-BY-4.0 project materials; inspect each source list.
datasets.redistribution: Do not vendor downloaded DNS audio in this repo.
datasets.format: clean speech, noise, and impulse-response archives
datasets.size: about 550 GB archived and about 1 TB unpacked for DNS5 full data
notes: Too large for the default starter workflow.
Use selected noise or RIR subsets only after checking source licenses.
